download_dataset: download a BEIR dataset like fiqa or msmarco to a specified directory
extract_dataset: extract a zip dataset archive into a target input directory
load_dataset: load queries and corpus jsonl files into id-to-text mappings
update_loft_dataset: fill missing query_text and passage_text fields in LOFT dataset files
extract_video_resource: extract video frames from msrvtt mp4 files into image resources
